plans.note: Sec 21.1 caps both parties at one month of Fees paid 'without exception', which would swallow the Excluded Claims in 21.3; push to 12 months' Fees with uncapped/super-capped carve-outs reconciled to 21.3 and 21.4.

Section 20 contains only a broad Customer-side indemnity (20.1) and no Vendor IP/misconduct indemnity; note the dangling cross-reference to 'Section 20.5' in sec-9.3. Add Vendor IP, data/security, personal injury and law-violation indemnities and narrow the Customer indemnity.
Sec 12.4 imposes a 24-month worldwide non-compete on Customer and directly contradicts the freedom-to-operate language in 12.3; strike 12.4.
Sec-2.2 (first of two paragraphs numbered 2.2) makes Vendor sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics; delete as inconsistent with 12.3's no-exclusivity acknowledgement.
No MFN obligation on Customer appears; 12.3 expressly disclaims any most-favoured-customer commitment. Verify pricing sections 7.1 and 8.3 for any hidden best-terms undertaking before clearing.
No non-solicit binding Customer located; 12.3 confirms no no-hire commitment and preserves general recruitment. Confirm nothing in personnel/independent-contractor provisions adds one.

Sec 9.4 gives us 30-day convenience termination with prepaid refunds and denies Vendor a reciprocal right — playbook-compliant; check interaction with the take-or-pay commitment in 2.1 which purports to bar termination.
Sec 8.2 (30-day opt-out plus 60-day reminder) and 8.3 (CPI/3% cap, 90-day notice) largely meet our position; confirm no conflicting renewal or uplift terms are pushed into Order Forms.
New York law and exclusive New York County courts with no arbitration — acceptable; verify 28.3's pre-suit executive process does not bar urgent relief.

24.1–24.4 give us affiliate/successor assignment and block Vendor exit or repricing on our change of control; check 24.3's residual consent requirement does not undercut 24.1 and that 13.3 licence transfer aligns.

Ownership of Customer Data (14.1) and Deliverables (14.2) sits with us; scrutinise the 'subject to payment' condition, the Vendor Technology carve-out in 1.4/1.8, and 15.1's improvement/model-training limits.

Sec 13.1 grants a Customer-only licence revocable at Vendor's sole discretion and excludes Affiliates and contractors — replace with non-revocable scope covering Affiliates/contractors, consistent with 13.2 and 13.3.
22.1–22.3 give annual frequency, 30-day notice, off-site preference and Vendor-borne costs; confirm the 5% shift threshold and that Section 23 records duties do not create a broader access right.

No liquidated damages or penalty payable by Customer found; the closest exposures are the take-or-pay in 2.1 and audit-cost shifting in 22.2. Also check for absence of service credits owed to us (no SLA/credit section is present).
Sec 19.2's 15-day Deliverable warranty with no post-period correction or refund duty is far below our 12-month position; extend and preserve the 19.4 remedy plus non-exclusivity.
Insurance is present with cyber, E&O, CGL and workers' comp; check limits against playbook minimums and the certificate/notice-of-cancellation mechanics in 18.2.

Sec 2.1 imposes a USD 2M/year three-year take-or-pay with no reduction or termination rights; delete or make the commitment subject to the 9.4 convenience right and 12.3's no-minimum-volume acknowledgement.

Sec 11.1 requires immediate cessation of assistance and deletion with no export, contradicting 11.2/11.3 and 10.1's transition period; replace with a priced transition-assistance period and data return on request.
